Yam-Akara

Biography

Yam-Akara is a magician whose inexpensive runes anger Karansul. Suspicion falls on him in Brissen’s murder, but his visit to the mines and the guard’s testimony provide an alibi. After being cleared, he searches the governor’s library and identifies the old passage that can take Kir home to Jigran. [1, 2, 3, 4]
